title.zh: 棘皮动物来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Echinodermata to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开棘皮动物，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Echinoderms time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的棘皮动物时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Compare echinodermata and crinoidea through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较echinodermata与crinoidea；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: 约 510 Ma 的关节相连棘皮动物群

description.en: Inspect the map at the source-bounded age of articulated Gondwanan faunas with multiple differentiated echinoderm body plans.
description.zh: 在地图中检查冈瓦纳关节相连棘皮动物群的来源限定年代；该材料保存多个分化的棘皮动物体型。

limitations: This card maps a source-bounded articulated-fauna datum. It does not convert the Gondwanan samples into a global origin, complete distribution, direct ancestry, or one ancestral ecology.

title.en: Crinoid record in the middle Tremadocian
title.zh: 特马豆克期中期的海百合记录

description.en: Inspect the map at the rounded middle-Tremadocian age used for the unproblematic crinoid fossil record.
description.zh: 在地图中检查用于无争议海百合化石记录的、经取整的特马豆克期中期年代。

limitations: The rounded route age represents the source-bounded middle Tremadocian record, not a point-dated global first appearance; problematic Echmatocrinus is excluded by the linked claim.

title.en: Asteroid body fossil at the top Tremadocian
title.zh: 特马豆克期顶部的海星纲体化石

description.en: Inspect the map at the rounded age of the Eriaster body-fossil record from the very top of the Tremadocian.
description.zh: 在地图中检查 Eriaster 位于特马豆克期最顶部的体化石记录所对应的取整年代。

limitations: This route preserves the Eriaster body-fossil boundary and does not treat problematic Asteriacites traces as an asteroid range endpoint, global distribution, or direct ancestry.

title.en: Ophiuran material at the Floian ceiling
title.zh: 弗洛期上限的蛇尾纲材料

description.en: Inspect the map at the Floian stage ceiling used for the source-bounded Stenaster ophiuran occurrence.
description.zh: 在地图中检查用于来源限定 Stenaster 蛇尾纲出现记录的弗洛期阶段上限。

limitations: The route uses a stage ceiling rather than a point-dated first appearance. The cited Wah Wah Formation occurrence is not a global ophiuran distribution, origin, or behavioural observation.

title.zh: 达瑞威尔期的干群海胆骨板

description.en: Inspect the map at the Darriwilian age of the disarticulated bothriocidaroid plates used for the echinoid total-group record.
description.zh: 在地图中检查用于海胆总群记录的、达瑞威尔期不相连的 bothriocidaroid 骨板年代。

limitations: The linked record is disarticulated total-group material. It does not date crown Echinoidea, establish a global origin or distribution, or infer an ancestral ecology.

title.en: Articulated holothurian record in the late Darriwilian
title.zh: 达瑞威尔期晚期的关节相连海参纲记录

description.en: Inspect the map at the rounded late-Darriwilian age of the articulated Oesolcucumaria record from the Holothurian Bed.
description.zh: 在地图中检查 Holothurian Bed 的关节相连 Oesolcucumaria 记录所对应的取整达瑞威尔期晚期年代。

limitations: This card retains the articulated Welsh specimen and locality boundary; disputed Cambrian material is not used as an endpoint, and the card does not establish global distribution, ancestry, or class-wide behaviour.

title.zh: 约 255 Ma 的海蕾纲末次记录

description.en: Inspect the map at the Wuchiapingian age used for the reported blastoid last occurrence near 255 Ma.
description.zh: 在地图中检查用于海蕾纲约 255 Ma 报道末次出现记录的吴家坪期年代。

limitations: The Wuchiapingian point is the reported observed last record, not a Permian–Triassic extinction inference, complete blastoid distribution, or causal account of disappearance.
